title: 第289章 星舰降临第288章 天价
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
看着冷下场来的大厅。
魔法帝国的那位老法师也不气馁，这本就不是给所有人准备的。
就算他们不买，三大势力也能吃的下。
只是给这些势力一个机会罢了。
会议厅里的投影演示结束后，老法师开口：
“湮灭星舰学城现在正好有一艘，我可以带领大家去现场看看实物。”
这话一出，其他人也顾不得开会了，反正今天的会议内容也讨论的差不多了。
纷纷跟着老法师涌向学城的外港方向。
罗恩混在人群里，身边跟着玛格丽特，两人走得不算快，但也没落下。
出了学城西门，视野豁然开朗。
外港的夜色被无数五颜六色的魔法灯照亮，一条长长的栈桥延伸向海面，两侧站满了提前抵达的卫兵。
更远处还围着一大群学城本地居民，他们都是跟来见见世面的。
所有人都仰着头，朝同一个方向看去。
突然！
海面上方的夜空亮如白昼。
罗恩抬起头，天空上方原本像是厚重幕布般的云层，仿佛被两只手从两侧缓缓撕开一样。
裂隙边缘泛着淡蓝色的幽光，空气中弥漫着一股细微的震颤感，像是有什么东西正在穿过空间的壁垒朝这边挤过来。
裂隙越扩越大，然后一道暗银色的轮廓从裂缝中缓缓探出，像是一座倒悬的山峰正在从夜空中生长出来。
它出来得很慢。
第一缕银光从裂隙边缘渗出时，外港的人群中已经有人，不由自主地往后退了半步。

随着船头完全脱离亚空间，整艘巨舰的轮廓在夜色中逐渐变得完整，那种压迫感不是投影能模拟的。
投影里的画面再宏大，也只是一帧图像。
而当三十多公里长的实物悬浮在头顶时，它几乎遮蔽了半边星空。
船身上密集的灯火像一座倒悬在空中的城市，每一盏灯都代表着一块你无法忽略的金属块。
它停住了。
大约在三四千米的高空，巨舰的船身轻轻晃动了一下。
像是调整了一个极细微的角度，然后稳稳地悬浮在那里。
但就是这对于星舰只是一次轻微晃动的调整，对下面的人来说，不亚于天要坠下来了。
下方的人群都被惊倒一片，有些老六还掏出了保命底牌。
远遁几十里开外了。
罗恩也被吓了一跳。
上方那个玩意要是真结结实实砸下来，他也不知道自己能挡的住不。
兴许往地下打个深洞，应该能活下来。
湮灭星舰的阴影从海面一直延伸到外港栈桥上，把所有人的脸都笼在一层暗色的灰纱里。
只有路边的灯火从照耀，把那些仰望的面孔照得明明灭灭。
没有人说话。
过了好几息，才有人发出一声像是从喉咙里挤出来的、带着不可置信的感慨：
“……这么大。”
这句话像是打开了某个阀门，周围的人群忽然像是活了过来，细碎的议论声此起彼伏地响起：
“我刚才在投影里看的时候，觉得也就那样，现在亲眼看到……这比整个外港还大吧？”
content_en:
Looking at the hall where Leng Xiuchi came.
The old mage from the Magic Empire is not discouraged. This is not for everyone.
Even if they don't buy it, the three major forces can still eat it.
Just give these forces a chance.
After the projection demonstration in the conference hall ended, the old mage spoke:
"There happens to be one in the Annihilation Starfleet Academy right now. I can take everyone to the site to see the real thing."
As soon as these words came out, others no longer cared about the meeting. Anyway, the content of today's meeting was almost completed.
They all followed the old mage towards the outer harbor of the school city.
Ron blended into the crowd, followed by Margaret. The two of them didn't walk very fast, but they didn't fall behind either.
After leaving the west gate of the school city, the view suddenly opened up.
The night in the outer harbor was illuminated by countless colorful magic lights. A long trestle stretched toward the sea, and both sides were lined with guards who had arrived in advance.
Further away, there was a large group of local residents of the school city surrounding them, all of whom had come to see the world.
Everyone raised their heads and looked in the same direction.
Sudden!
The night sky above the sea is as bright as day.
Ron raised his head. The clouds above the sky, which were originally like thick curtains, seemed to be slowly torn apart from both sides by two hands.
There was a pale blue light glowing at the edge of the crack, and there was a slight tremor in the air, as if something was squeezing through the barrier of space and coming towards this side.
The crack widened, and then a dark silver outline slowly emerged from the crack, like an upside-down mountain growing out of the night sky.
It comes out very slowly.
When the first ray of silver light seeped out from the edge of the crack, there were already people in the crowd in the outer port, and they involuntarily took half a step back.
As the bow of the ship completely left the subspace, the outline of the entire giant ship gradually became complete in the night. The sense of oppression cannot be simulated by projection.
No matter how grand the picture in the projection is, it is just a frame of image.
And when the object, which is more than thirty kilometers long, is suspended overhead, it almost blocks half of the starry sky.
The dense lights on the ship are like a city hanging upside down in the sky, and each light represents a piece of metal that you cannot ignore.
It stopped.
At an altitude of about three to four thousand meters, the hull of the giant ship shook slightly.
It was like adjusting a very slight angle and then floating there steadily.
But this is just a slight shaking adjustment for the starship. To the people below, it is no less than the sky falling.
The crowd below were all shocked, and some of them even took out their life-saving cards.
It's dozens of miles away.
Ron was also shocked.
If the thing above really hit him hard, he didn't know if he could stop it.
Maybe if you dig a deep hole underground, you should be able to survive.
The shadow of the Annihilated Starship stretched from the sea to the outer harbor pier, shrouding everyone's faces in a dark gray gauze.
Only the lights on the roadside were shining brightly, illuminating the faces looking up.
No one spoke.
After several breaths, someone uttered an unbelievable sigh that seemed to be squeezed out of the throat:
"...so big."
This sentence seemed to open a certain valve, and the crowd around him suddenly seemed to come alive, and small comments sounded one after another:
"When I saw it on the projection just now, I thought it was just like that. Now I see it with my own eyes...isn't it bigger than the entire Outer Harbor?"
